name: Test - scoped rules
description: A test theme for step 3f-2; it does not ship. The global accent turns orange, so focus rings, ticked checkboxes, the slider and a focused field's border follow it. Every text field in the inspector gets a darker fill through a panel-and-kind rule. The Stop button alone turns red, through a rule of its own and a local variable. The name field alone takes a violet border from another local variable, while the notes field keeps the global one.
